issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires defining `status_flag` as a single byte (a byte-sized data item). The provided solution declares `status_flag` as `dd 1`, which defines a 4-byte doubleword, not a single byte. This size/type mismatch between the specification and the solution can confuse students about the correct declaration and may cause grading or runtime inconsistencies if the flag size matters.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the solution's declaration of status_flag to a single byte to match the problem statement, e.g. use `status_flag db 1` (instead of `status_flag dd 1`). Also update any comments or documentation to reflect the byte-sized requirement.
